test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states won the ‘Best Tableau’ award at the 71st Republic Day parade in January 2020 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Defence Minister Rajnath Singh gave away Best Tableaux awards for Republic Day Parade, 2020 in New Delhi on 28 Jan 2020.
 
• Assam__'s tableau which portrayed the unique craftsmanship and culture of the state has been chosen as the best tableau.
 
• The tableau of National Disaster Relief Force and Jal Shakti Mission were chosen as the best among the Ministries and Departments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Odisha and Uttar Pradesh **were tied for the second position.
 
• The tableau of Odisha displayed the famous** Rukuna Ratha Yatra of Lord Lingaraja** while the tableau of Uttar Pradesh mirrored the cultural and religious tourism of the state with the theme **'Sarva Dharma Sama Bhav'.**
 
• Assam: State Animal - **Indian Rhinoceros**
 
• State Bird - **White-winged duck**
